brief:
A United Nations body has raised concerns that Israel's Operation Iron Wall constitutes ethnic cleansing in the West Bank, according to Al Jazeera English. The UN statement comes as more than 33,000 Palestinian refugees have remained displaced since the military operation began, marking a significant humanitarian toll from the campaign in the occupied territory.

The UN's characterization reflects mounting international scrutiny of Israeli military actions in the West Bank. The displacement of Palestinian civilians during Operation Iron Wall has drawn attention from international bodies monitoring humanitarian conditions and potential violations of international law in the region.
dek: More than 33,000 Palestinian refugees remain displaced since Israel launched Operation Iron Wall.
title: UN raises ethnic cleansing concerns over Israeli West Bank operation
